verdict.rationale: First-party docs state Omarchy ships nineteen built-in themes selectable via Style > Theme or a dedicated `Super + Ctrl + Shift + Space` theme-selector hotkey. A theme restyles the whole system at once: terminal, bar, notifications and wallpaper, with theme matching extended to VSCode, Cursor, VSCodium, Helix and Zed. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of theme switching and how instant it is.
